# Advanced Account Hub setup creates a backend account before opening settings

The advanced-config handler takes the current form values and calls advancedSetup. Accepted source checks for an existing incoming server, asks for confirmation, creates the backend account and opens Account Settings through moveToAccountManager. That route requests Hub close and resets the flow. It differs from the ordinary validation/authentication route. The tests check persisted incoming/outgoing ports and identity after choosing advanced setup; they do not show that this route verifies a connection or password before creating the account. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.

Scope: mail/components/accountcreation.
